english: Cooking is a skill that lets you make all kinds of delicious food that will typically restore your Hitpoints, amongst providing other benefits.
translation: 烹饪是一项技能，可以让你制作各种美味的食物，通常可以恢复你的生命值，并提供其他好处。 [peng ren shi yi xiang ji neng ， ke yi rang ni zhi zuo ge zhong mei wei de shi wu ， tong chang ke yi hui fu ni de sheng ming zhi ， bing ti gong qi ta hao chu 。]

english: At its most basic, Cooking can be done by simply taking raw meats and fish to either a fire or a range. You'll get better results overall if you use a range, though.
translation: 最基本的，烹饪只需将生肉和鱼放在火上或炉灶上即可完成。不过，如果使用范围，总体上会得到更好的结果。 [zui ji ben de ， peng ren zhi xu jiang sheng rou he yu fang zai huo shang huo lu zao shang ji ke wan cheng 。 bu guo ， ru guo shi yong fan wei ， zong ti shang hui de dao geng hao de jie guo 。]

english: Some foods will require you to prepare your ingredients before you can cook them. For example, you first need to mix flour and water into a dough before you can bake them into bread.
translation: 有些食物需要您先准备好原料，然后才能烹饪。例如，您首先需要将面粉和水混合成面团，然后才能将它们烤成面包。 [you xie shi wu xu yao nin xian zhun bei hao yuan liao ， ran hou cai neng peng ren 。 li ru ， nin shou xian xu yao jiang mian fen he shui hun he cheng mian tuan ， ran hou cai neng jiang ta men kao cheng mian bao 。]

english: As your Cooking level increases, you'll get access to an increasing list of recipes. You'll also find that you accidentally burn your food less of the time as well.
translation: 随着您的烹饪水平提高，您将获得越来越多的食谱。您还会发现不小心烧焦食物的次数也减少了。 [sui zhe nin de peng ren shui ping ti gao ， nin jiang huo de yue lai yue duo de shi pu 。 nin hai hui fa xian bu xiao xin shao jiao shi wu de ci shu ye jian shao le 。]

english: Crafting is a wide-ranging skill that allows you to create various pieces of armour, jewellery, equipment and more.

english: To craft armour out of animal hides, you'll typically first need to take the hides to a tanner to get them tanned, then combine them with a needle and thread, which can be acquired from certain crafting shops in the world.
translation: 要用动物皮制作盔甲，您通常首先需要将兽皮带到制革厂进行鞣制，然后将它们与针和线结合起来，针和线可以从世界上的某些手工艺店获得。 [yao yong dong wu pi zhi zuo kui jia ， nin tong chang shou xian xu yao jiang shou pi dai dao zhi ge chang jin xing rou zhi ， ran hou jiang ta men yu zhen he xian jie he qi lai ， zhen he xian ke yi cong shi jie shang de mou xie shou gong yi dian huo de 。]

english: To make pottery, you'll need to obtain some soft clay, obtained by adding water to clay. You can then use a pottery wheel to shape the clay into an unfired item, which you can then finish in a pottery oven.

english: To make jewellery, you'll need to first get a crafting mould. You can then take that mould and some gold or silver bars to a furnace to craft your jewellery. At higher crafting levels, you can cut gems and mould them simultaneously to create jewellery which you can enchant!
translation: 要制作珠宝，您首先需要获得一个工艺模具。然后，您可以将模具和一些金条或银条放入熔炉中制作珠宝。在更高的制作水平下，您可以切割宝石并同时成型它们，以创造出可以附魔的珠宝！ [yao zhi zuo zhu bao ， nin shou xian xu yao huo de yi ge gong yi mu ju 。 ran hou ， nin ke yi jiang mu ju he yi xie jin tiao huo yin tiao fang ru rong lu zhong zhi zuo zhu bao 。 zai geng gao de zhi zuo shui ping xia ， nin ke yi qie ge bao shi bing tong shi cheng xing ta men ， yi chuang zao chu ke yi fu mo de zhu bao ！]

translation: 农业可以让你在吉利诺的农田里种植各种花卉、蔬菜、树木、药草等。 [nong ye ke yi rang ni zai ji li nuo de nong tian li zhong zhi ge zhong hua hui 、 shu cai 、 shu mu 、 yao cao deng 。]

english: To get started, you'll need some seeds and a seed dibber, as well as a rake to de-weed the patch you want to use.
translation: 首先，您需要一些种子和播种机，以及用于为您要使用的土地除草的耙子。 [shou xian ， nin xu yao yi xie zhong zi he bo zhong ji ， yi ji yong yu wei nin yao shi yong de tu di chu cao de pa zi 。]

english: Once you've cleared the patch, you can add your seed to it. You can also optionally water it with a watering can or add a bucket of compost to decrease the chances of your plant becoming diseased.
translation: 清除补丁后，您可以将种子添加到其中。您还可以选择用喷壶浇水或添加一桶堆肥，以减少植物患病的机会。 [qing chu bu ding hou ， nin ke yi jiang zhong zi tian jia dao qi zhong 。 nin hai ke yi xuan ze yong pen hu jiao shui huo tian jia yi tong dui fei ， yi jian shao zhi wu huan bing de ji hui 。]

english: It'll take a while for your plant to grow, so feel free to explore the world and come back to it later!
translation: 你的植物需要一段时间才能生长，所以请随意探索世界，稍后再回来！ [ni de zhi wu xu yao yi duan shi jian cai neng sheng zhang ， suo yi qing sui yi tan suo shi jie ， shao hou zai hui lai ！]

english: Once your plant has grown, you might need another tool to collect the harvest. For instance, you'll need a shovel to dig up potatoes.
translation: 一旦你的植物生长完毕，你可能需要另一种工具来收集收获物。例如，您需要一把铲子来挖土豆。 [yi dan ni de zhi wu sheng zhang wan bi ， ni ke neng xu yao ling yi zhong gong ju lai shou ji shou huo wu 。 li ru ， nin xu yao yi ba chan zi lai wa tu dou 。]

translation: 成员现在可以燃烧桃花心木原木、燃烧枫木柴堆原木、挥舞布鲁玛火把并进入温特托特的监狱。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi ran shao tao hua xin mu yuan mu 、 ran shao feng mu chai dui yuan mu 、 hui wu bu lu ma huo ba bing jin ru wen te tuo te de jian yu 。]

english: Members can now replace Dorgeshuun Light Orbs.
translation: 会员现在可以更换 Dorgeshuun 光球。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi geng huan  Dorgeshuun  guang qiu 。]

english: Members can now burn Mahogany Pyre Logs.
translation: 会员现在可以燃烧桃花心木柴堆原木。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi ran shao tao hua xin mu chai dui yuan mu 。]

english: You can now burn Yew Logs and light an Abyssal Lantern with Yew Logs.
translation: 你现在可以燃烧紫杉木并用紫杉木点燃深渊灯笼。 [ni xian zai ke yi ran shao zi sha mu bing yong zi sha mu dian ran shen yuan deng long 。]

english: You can now burn Blisterwood Logs and light an Abyssal Lantern with Blisterwood Logs.
translation: 你现在可以燃烧起泡木原木并用起泡木原木点燃深渊灯笼。 [ni xian zai ke yi ran shao qi pao mu yuan mu bing yong qi pao mu yuan mu dian ran shen yuan deng long 。]

english: Members can now light Cave Goblin Mining Helmets and burn Yew Pyre Logs.
translation: 会员现在可以点燃洞穴妖精采矿头盔并燃烧红豆杉柴堆原木。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi dian ran dong xue yao jing cai kuang tou kui bing ran shao hong dou shan chai dui yuan mu 。]

english: Members can now light Troll Fires.
translation: 成员现在可以点燃巨魔之火。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi dian ran ju mo zhi huo 。]

english: You can now burn Larch Logs.
translation: 您现在可以燃烧落叶松原木。 [nin xian zai ke yi ran shao luo ye song yuan mu 。]

english: You can now burn Magic Logs and light an Abyssal Lantern with Magic Logs.
translation: 你现在可以燃烧魔法原木并用魔法原木点燃深渊灯笼。 [ni xian zai ke yi ran shao mo fa yuan mu bing yong mo fa yuan mu dian ran shen yuan deng long 。]

english: Members can now burn Magic Pyre Logs.
translation: 会员现在可以燃烧魔法柴堆原木。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi ran shao mo fa chai dui yuan mu 。]

english: Members can now create Infernal Axes.
translation: 成员现在可以创建地狱斧。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi chuang jian di yu fu 。]

english: You can now burn Redwood Logs and light an Abyssal Lantern with Redwood Logs.
translation: 您现在可以燃烧红木原木并用红木原木点燃深渊灯笼。 [nin xian zai ke yi ran shao hong mu yuan mu bing yong hong mu yuan mu dian ran shen yuan deng long 。]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Firemaking. Why not visit Ignatius, south of Seers' Village? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Firmaking skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是生火大师了。为什么不去参观先知村南边的伊格内修斯呢？他有一些特殊的东西，只有真正的紧实技能大师才能使用！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi sheng huo da shi le 。 wei shen me bu qu can guan xian zhi cun nan bian de yi ge nei xiu si ne ？ ta you yi xie te shu de dong xi ， zhi you zhen zheng de jin shi ji neng da shi cai neng shi yong ！]

english: Fishing allows you to gather fish at various points across Gielinor. Typically, these will be indicated by moving bubbles on the surface of the water.
translation: 钓鱼可以让您在吉利诺各地的不同地点收集鱼。通常，这些将通过水面上移动的气泡来指示。 [diao yu ke yi rang nin zai ji li nuo ge di de bu tong di dian shou ji yu 。 tong chang ， zhe xie jiang tong guo shui mian shang yi dong de qi pao lai zhi shi 。]

english: Different fish require different equipment to catch; for instance, you need a fishing net to catch shrimp, but a fishing rod and bait to catch sardines.
translation: 不同的鱼需要不同的设备来捕捉；例如，捕虾需要渔网，但捕沙丁鱼需要鱼竿和鱼饵。 [bu tong de yu xu yao bu tong de she bei lai bu zhuo ； li ru ， bu xia xu yao yu wang ， dan bu sha ding yu xu yao yu gan he yu er 。]

english: As your Fishing level increases, you'll gain access to more varieties of fish to catch, as well as having a higher chance of successfully catching fish when you try.
translation: 随着钓鱼水平的提高，您将能够捕获更多种类的鱼，并且在尝试时成功捕获鱼的机会也会更高。 [sui zhe diao yu shui ping de ti gao ， nin jiang neng gou bu huo geng duo zhong lei de yu ， bing qie zai chang shi shi cheng gong bu huo yu de ji hui ye hui geng gao 。]

english: You can now try fishing for sardines. Members can now try fishing for karambwanji.
translation: 您现在可以尝试钓沙丁鱼。会员现在可以尝试钓鱼 karambwanji。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi diao sha ding yu 。 hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi diao yu  karambwanji。]

english: You can now try fishing for guppies.
translation: 您现在可以尝试钓鱼孔雀鱼。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi diao yu kong que yu 。]

english: You can now try fishing for herring.
translation: 您现在可以尝试钓鲱鱼。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi diao fei yu 。]

english: You can now try to net anchovies. Members can collect fresh fish from Piscarilius docks and catch Suphi fish.
translation: 现在您可以尝试网捕凤尾鱼。会员可以从Piscarilius码头收集新鲜的鱼并捕获Suphi鱼。 [xian zai nin ke yi chang shi wang bu feng wei yu 。 hui yuan ke yi cong Piscarilius ma tou shou ji xin xian de yu bing bu huo Suphi yu 。]

english: Members can now try fishing for mackerel, oysters and caskets with a large net.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试用大网捕捞鲭鱼、牡蛎和棺材。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi yong da wang bu lao qing yu 、 mu li he guan cai 。]

english: You can now try fly fishing for trout and cavefish. Members can try fishing for Bream with a big net in Neypotzli.
translation: 您现在可以尝试飞钓鳟鱼和洞穴鱼。会员可以在内波茨利尝试用大网捕捞鳊鱼。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi fei diao zun yu he dong xue yu 。 hui yuan ke yi zai nei bo ci li chang shi yong da wang bu lao bian yu 。]

english: Members can now try fishing for cod with a large net.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试用大网捕捞鳕鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi yong da wang bu lao xue yu 。]

english: You can now try fishing for pike.
translation: 您现在可以尝试钓梭子鱼。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi diao suo zi yu 。]

english: Members can now try fishing for slimy eels.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试钓粘鳗鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi diao zhan man yu 。]

english: New information is available from the Fishing Tutor south of Lumbridge.
translation: 新信息可从朗布里奇以南的钓鱼导师那里获得。 [xin xin xi ke cong lang bu li qi yi nan de diao yu dao shi na li huo de 。]

english: You can now try fly fishing for salmon. Members can catch Leckish fish.
translation: 您现在可以尝试飞钓鲑鱼。会员可以钓莱克什鱼。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi fei diao gui yu 。 hui yuan ke yi diao lai ke shen yu 。]

english: You can now try fishing for tetra. Members can now try to net giant frogspawn.
translation: 您现在可以尝试钓鱼四。会员现在可以尝试捕获巨型青蛙卵。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi diao yu si 。 hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi bu huo ju xing qing wa luan 。]

english: Members can now wear the Angler outfit.
translation: 会员现在可以穿着钓鱼者服装。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chuan zhe diao yu zhe fu zhuang 。]

english: You can now try harpooning tuna. Members can now fight the Tempoross.
translation: 您现在可以尝试用鱼叉捕金枪鱼。成员现在可以对抗Tempoross。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi yong yu cha bu jin qiang yu 。 cheng yuan xian zai ke yi dui kang Tempoross。]

english: Members can now try fishing for cave eels and rainbow fish.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试钓鱼洞穴鳗鱼和彩虹鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi diao yu dong xue man yu he cai hong yu 。]

english: You can now try to catch lobsters.
translation: 您现在可以尝试捕捉龙虾。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi bu zhuo long xia 。]

english: Members can now catch bluegill on Molch Island (with 35 hunter).
translation: 会员现在可以在 Molch 岛上捕捉翻车鱼（有 35 名猎人）。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai  Molch  dao shang bu zhuo fan che yu （ you  35  ming lie ren ）。]

english: Members can now catch Brawk fish.
translation: 会员现在可以捕捉 Brawk 鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi bu zhuo  Brawk  yu 。]

english: Members can now try fishing for sea bass and catfish with a large net.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试用大网捕捞鲈鱼和鲶鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi yong da wang bu lao lu yu he nian yu 。]

english: Members can now access drift net fishing on fossil island[sic] (with 44 hunter).
translation: 会员现在可以在化石岛上使用流网捕鱼[原文如此]（有 44 名猎人）。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai hua shi dao shang shi yong liu wang bu yu [ yuan wen ru ci ]（ you  44  ming lie ren ）。]

english: Members can now try fishing for leaping trout.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试钓跳鳟鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi diao tiao zun yu 。]

english: You can now try harpooning swordfish.
translation: 您现在可以尝试用鱼叉捕箭鱼。 [nin xian zai ke yi chang shi yong yu cha bu jian yu 。]

english: Members can now try catching lava eels.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试捕捉熔岩鳗鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi bu zhuo rong yan man yu 。]

english: Members can now catch common tench on Molch Island (with 51 hunter).
translation: 会员现在可以在 Molch 岛上捕捉普通丁丁鱼（有 51 名猎人）。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai  Molch  dao shang bu zhuo pu tong ding ding yu （ you  51  ming lie ren ）。]

english: Members can now try fishing for leaping salmon.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试钓跳跃鲑鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi diao tiao yue gui yu 。]

english: Members can now catch Mycil fish.
translation: 会员现在可以捕获 Mycil 鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi bu huo  Mycil  yu 。]

english: Members can now use dragon harpoons.
translation: 会员现在可以使用龙鱼叉。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong long yu cha 。]

english: Members can now try netting monkfish.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试网安康鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi wang an kang yu 。]

english: Members can now try catching karambwan.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试捕捉 karambwan。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi bu zhuo  karambwan。]

english: Members are now qualified to enter the Fishing Guild.
translation: 会员现已具备进入钓鱼公会的资格。 [hui yuan xian yi ju bei jin ru diao yu gong hui de zi ge 。]

english: Members can now try fishing for leaping sturgeon.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试钓跳鲟。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi diao tiao xun 。]

english: Members can now use crystal harpoons.
translation: 会员现在可以使用水晶鱼叉。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong shui jing yu cha 。]

english: Members can now catch mottled eel on Molch Island (with 68 hunter).
translation: 会员现在可以在 Molch 岛捕获斑鳗（有 68 名猎人）。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai  Molch  dao bu huo ban man （ you  68  ming lie ren ）。]

english: Members can now catch Roqed fish.
translation: 会员现在可以捕获 Roqed 鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi bu huo  Roqed  yu 。]

english: Members can now catch Roqed fish and create the infernal harpoon.
translation: 成员现在可以捕获 Roqed 鱼并制造地狱鱼叉。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi bu huo  Roqed  yu bing zhi zao di yu yu cha 。]

english: Members can now try harpooning sharks.
translation: 会员现在可以尝试用鱼叉捕鲨鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi chang shi yong yu cha bu sha yu 。]

english: Members can now catch sea turtles.
translation: 会员现在可以捕捉海龟。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi bu zhuo hai gui 。]

english: Members can now catch infernal eels in Mor Ul Rek.
translation: 会员现在可以在 Mor Ul Rek 捕捉地狱鳗鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai  Mor Ul Rek  bu zhuo di yu man yu 。]

english: Members can now catch manta rays.
translation: 会员现在可以捕捉蝠鲼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi bu zhuo fu fen 。]

english: Members can now catch anglerfish in Port Piscarilius and minnows in the Fishing Guild.
translation: 会员现在可以在皮斯卡利留斯港捕捉琵琶鱼，在钓鱼公会捕捉小鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai pi si ka li liu si gang bu zhuo pi pa yu ， zai diao yu gong hui bu zhuo xiao yu 。]

english: Members can now catch Dark Crabs in the Wilderness.
translation: 会员现在可以在荒野中捕捉黑蟹。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai huang ye zhong bu zhuo hei xie 。]

english: Members can now catch sacred eels in Zul-Andra.
translation: 会员现在可以在祖尔安德拉捕捉神圣的鳗鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai zu er an de la bu zhuo shen sheng de man yu 。]

english: Members can now catch Kyren fish.
translation: 会员现在可以捕捉凯伦鱼。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi bu zhuo kai lun yu 。]

english: Members can now catch greater siren on Molch Island (with 87 hunter).
translation: 会员现在可以在莫尔奇岛捕获更大的海妖（有 87 个猎人）。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai mo er qi dao bu huo geng da de hai yao （ you  87  ge lie ren ）。]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Fishing. Why not visit the Master Fisherman at the Fishing Guild? There you can buy something special that is only available to true masters of the Fishing skill!
translation: 恭喜！您现在是钓鱼大师了。为什么不去拜访钓鱼公会的渔夫大师呢？在那里您可以买到只有真正的钓鱼技巧大师才能买到的特殊物品！ [gong xi ！ nin xian zai shi diao yu da shi le 。 wei shen me bu qu bai fang diao yu gong hui de yu fu da shi ne ？ zai na li nin ke yi mai dao zhi you zhen zheng de diao yu ji qiao da shi cai neng mai dao de te shu wu pin ！]

english: Fletching allows you to create various ranged weapons, as well as ammunition to go with them.
translation: 箭羽可以让你制造各种远程武器以及与之配套的弹药。 [jian yu ke yi rang ni zhi zao ge zhong yuan cheng wu qi yi ji yu zhi pei tao de dan yao 。]

english: Making bows requires bowstring, which can be made from flax at a spinning wheel. You can use a knife on some logs to carve an unfinished bow, then add the bowstring to complete the weapon.
translation: 制作弓需要弓弦，弓弦可以在纺车上用亚麻制成。你可以用刀在一些原木上雕刻出未完成的弓，然后添加弓弦来完成武器。 [zhi zuo gong xu yao gong xian ， gong xian ke yi zai fang che shang yong ya ma zhi cheng 。 ni ke yi yong dao zai yi xie yuan mu shang diao ke chu wei wan cheng de gong ， ran hou tian jia gong xian lai wan cheng wu qi 。]

english: To create arrows, you’ll first need to carve logs into arrow shafts with a knife, then tip the arrow shafts with feathers. Finally, you’ll need to add some arrow heads.
translation: 要制作箭头，您首先需要用刀将原木雕刻成箭杆，然后用羽毛将箭杆削尖。最后，您需要添加一些箭头。 [yao zhi zuo jian tou ， nin shou xian xu yao yong dao jiang yuan mu diao ke cheng jian gan ， ran hou yong yu mao jiang jian gan xue jian 。 zui hou ， nin xu yao tian jia yi xie jian tou 。]

english: To make bolts, you only need to combine unfinished bolts with feathers. You can also chisel gemstones down into bolt tips, with each gemstone being able to top a different bolt.
translation: 要制作螺栓，您只需将未完成的螺栓与羽毛组合起来即可。您还可以将宝石凿入螺栓尖端，每个宝石都可以顶在不同的螺栓上。 [yao zhi zuo luo shuan ， nin zhi xu jiang wei wan cheng de luo shuan yu yu mao zu he qi lai ji ke 。 nin hai ke yi jiang bao shi zao ru luo shuan jian duan ， mei ge bao shi dou ke yi ding zai bu tong de luo shuan shang 。]

english: You can now make bronze javelins.
translation: 您现在可以制作青铜标枪。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo qing tong biao qiang 。]

english: You can now make shortbows.
translation: 您现在可以制作短弓。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo duan gong 。]

english: You can now make bronze 'brutal' arrows.
translation: 你现在可以制作青铜“残酷”箭头。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo qing tong “ can ku ” jian tou 。]

english: You can now make bronze/wooden crossbows and bronze crossbow bolts.
translation: 您现在可以制作青铜/木弩和青铜弩箭。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo qing tong / mu nu he qing tong nu jian 。]

english: You can now make longbows.
translation: 您现在可以制作长弓。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo zhang gong 。]

english: You can now make opal tipped bronze bolts.
translation: 您现在可以制作蛋白石尖青铜螺栓。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo dan bai shi jian qing tong luo shuan 。]

english: You can now make iron arrows.
translation: 您现在可以制作铁箭。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo tie jian 。]

english: You can now make iron javelins.
translation: 您现在可以制作铁标枪。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo tie biao qiang 。]

english: You can now make iron 'brutal' arrows.
translation: 你现在可以制作“残酷”的铁箭。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo “ can ku ” de tie jian 。]

english: You can now craft oak shortbows.
translation: 您现在可以制作橡木短弓。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo xiang mu duan gong 。]

english: You can now make iron darts.
translation: 您现在可以制作铁镖了。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo tie biao le 。]

english: You can now make oak longbows.
translation: 您现在可以制作橡木长弓。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo xiang mu zhang gong 。]

english: You can now make jade tipped blurite bolts.
translation: 你现在可以制作玉头蓝石螺栓。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo yu tou lan shi luo shuan 。]

english: You can now fletch oak shields.
translation: 你现在可以为橡木盾制作羽毛。 [ni xian zai ke yi wei xiang mu dun zhi zuo yu mao 。]

english: You can now make steel arrows and composite ogre bows.
translation: 你现在可以制作钢箭和复合食人魔弓。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo gang jian he fu he shi ren mo gong 。]

english: You can now make kebbit tipped bolts and steel javelins.
translation: 您现在可以制作带头螺栓和钢标枪。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo dai tou luo shuan he gang biao qiang 。]

english: You can now make steel 'brutal' arrows.
translation: 你现在可以制作“残酷”的钢箭。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo “ can ku ” de gang jian 。]

english: You can now make willow shortbows and bone shortbows.
translation: 你现在可以制作柳短弓和骨短弓。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo liu duan gong he gu duan gong 。]

english: You can now make steel darts.
translation: 您现在可以制作钢飞镖。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo gang fei biao 。]

english: You can now make black brutal arrows.
translation: 你现在可以制作黑色的残酷箭头。 [ni xian zai ke yi zhi zuo hei se de can ku jian tou 。]

english: You can now make iron/willow crossbows and iron crossbow bolts.
translation: 您现在可以制作铁/柳弩和铁弩箭。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo tie / liu nu he tie nu jian 。]

english: You can now make willow longbows and battlestaves.

english: Magic grants you access to a wide variety of spells. To cast each spell, you will need a specific set of runes. You can see the runes required by inspecting the spell in either the side panel, or in their tab in this skill guide.

english: Mining allows you to get various minerals from the world, for use in other skills; primarily Smithing.
translation: 采矿可以让你从世界上获取各种矿物质，用于其他技能；主要是史密斯。 [cai kuang ke yi rang ni cong shi jie shang huo qu ge zhong kuang wu zhi ， yong yu qi ta ji neng ； zhu yao shi shi mi si 。]

english: To mine a rock, simply interact with it while holding a pickaxe you have the level to use and you'll start mining it. Eventually, you'll collect the ore and the rock will deplete. Low level rocks will replenish themselves fairly quickly, but higher level ones will take longer and longer to come back.
translation: 要开采一块岩石，只需拿着一把镐与它互动，你就可以开始开采它。最终，你会收集矿石，而岩石会耗尽。低等级的岩石会很快地自我补充，但较高等级的岩石将需要越来越长的时间才能恢复。 [yao kai cai yi kuai yan shi ， zhi xu na zhe yi ba gao yu ta hu dong ， ni jiu ke yi kai shi kai cai ta 。 zui zhong ， ni hui shou ji kuang shi ， er yan shi hui hao jin 。 di deng ji de yan shi hui hen kuai di zi wo bu chong ， dan jiao gao deng ji de yan shi jiang xu yao yue lai yue zhang de shi jian cai neng hui fu 。]

english: At higher mining levels, you'll have an increased chance of successfully mining a rock. You'll also be able to use more powerful pickaxes, which decrease the amount of time between mining attempts.
translation: 在更高的采矿水平下，成功开采岩石的机会会增加。您还可以使用更强大的镐，这可以减少采矿尝试之间的时间。 [zai geng gao de cai kuang shui ping xia ， cheng gong kai cai yan shi de ji hui hui zeng jia 。 nin hai ke yi shi yong geng qiang da de gao ， zhe ke yi jian shao cai kuang chang shi zhi jian de shi jian 。]

english: Note that while most pickaxes have an Attack level requirement to equip them, you're still able to use them from within your inventory if you have the required Mining level.
translation: 请注意，虽然大多数镐都有攻击级别要求来装备它们，但如果您具有所需的采矿级别，您仍然可以从库存中使用它们。 [qing zhu yi ， sui ran da duo shu gao dou you gong ji ji bie yao qiu lai zhuang bei ta men ， dan ru guo nin ju you suo xu de cai kuang ji bie ， nin reng ran ke yi cong ku cun zhong shi yong ta men 。]

english: You can now mine Coal. Members can mine Pure Rune Essence and size-3 stars, and access the Motherlode mine.
translation: 您现在可以开采煤炭。会员可以开采纯符文精华和 3 颗星，并进入母矿矿。 [nin xian zai ke yi kai cai mei tan 。 hui yuan ke yi kai cai chun fu wen jing hua he  3  ke xing ， bing jin ru mu kuang kuang 。]

english: You can now mine with adamant pickaxes.
translation: 您现在可以使用坚固的镐进行开采。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong jian gu de gao jin xing kai cai 。]

english: Members can now mine Sandstone.
translation: 会员现在可以开采砂岩。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai sha yan 。]

english: Members can now mine Dense Essence.
translation: 会员现在可以开采浓密精华。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai nong mi jing hua 。]

english: You can now mine Gold. Members can mine Gem rocks and size-4 stars.
translation: 您现在可以开采黄金了。会员可以开采宝石和 4 颗星。 [nin xian zai ke yi kai cai huang jin le 。 hui yuan ke yi kai cai bao shi he  4  ke xing 。]

english: You can now mine with rune pickaxes and Gilded pickaxes. Members can mine Calcified deposits in Cam Torum.
translation: 您现在可以使用符文镐和镀金镐进行采矿。会员可以在卡姆托鲁姆开采钙化矿床。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong fu wen gao he du jin gao jin xing cai kuang 。 hui yuan ke yi zai ka mu tuo lu mu kai cai gai hua kuang chuang 。]

english: Members can now mine Volcanic Sulphur.
translation: 会员现在可以开采火山硫磺。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai huo shan liu huang 。]

english: Members can now use the Lovakengj Blast Mine.
translation: 会员现在可以使用 Lovakenj Blast Mine。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong  Lovakenj Blast Mine。]

english: Members can now mine Granite.
translation: 会员现在可以开采花岗岩。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai hua gang yan 。]

english: Members can now access the Volcano Mine (with 150 kudos) on Fossil Island, and mine size-5 stars.
translation: 会员现在可以进入化石岛上的火山矿（有 150 个荣誉），并开采 5 颗星的矿。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi jin ru hua shi dao shang de huo shan kuang （ you  150  ge rong yu ）， bing kai cai  5  ke xing de kuang 。]

english: You can now mine Mithril. Members can now equip Superior mining gloves.
translation: 你现在可以开采秘银了。会员现在可以装备高级采矿手套。 [ni xian zai ke yi kai cai mi yin le 。 hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhuang bei gao ji cai kuang shou tao 。]

english: You can now enter the world famous Mining Guild. Members can now mine Daeyalt Essence and size-6 stars.
translation: 您现在可以进入世界著名的采矿公会。会员现在可以开采 Daeyalt 精华和 6 号星星。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru shi jie zhu ming de cai kuang gong hui 。 hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai  Daeyalt  jing hua he  6  hao xing xing 。]

english: Members can now mine with dragon pickaxes and infernal pickaxes.
translation: 会员现在可以使用龙镐和地狱镐进行采矿。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong long gao he di yu gao jin xing cai kuang 。]

english: Members can now mine Tainted Essence Chunks within the Abyssal Scar.
translation: 成员现在可以在深渊伤痕中开采受污染的精华块。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi zai shen yuan shang hen zhong kai cai shou wu ran de jing hua kuai 。]

english: Members can now mine Lovakite.
translation: 会员现在可以开采 Lovakite。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai  Lovakite。]

english: You can now mine Adamantite. Members can now mine soft clay and size-7 stars, and equip Expert mining gloves.
translation: 您现在可以开采精金。会员现在可以开采软粘土和 7 号星，并装备专家采矿手套。 [nin xian zai ke yi kai cai jing jin 。 hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai ruan nian tu he  7  hao xing ， bing zhuang bei zhuan jia cai kuang shou tao 。]

english: Members can now mine with Crystal Pickaxes.
translation: 会员现在可以使用水晶镐进行挖矿。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong shui jing gao jin xing wa kuang 。]

english: Members can now mine Te Salt, Efh Salt, Urt Salt, and Basalt.
translation: 会员现在可以开采 Te 盐、Efh 盐、Urt 盐和玄武岩。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai  Te  yan 、Efh  yan 、Urt  yan he xuan wu yan 。]

english: Members can now mine Ancient essence.
translation: 会员现在可以开采远古精华。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai yuan gu jing hua 。]

english: Members can now mine size-8 stars.
translation: 会员现在可以开采 8 颗星。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai  8  ke xing 。]

english: You can now mine Runite.
translation: 您现在可以开采符石了。 [nin xian zai ke yi kai cai fu shi le 。]

english: Members can now mine size-9 stars.
translation: 会员现在可以开采 9 号星星。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai  9  hao xing xing 。]

english: Members can now mine Amethyst.
translation: 会员现在可以开采紫水晶。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kai cai zi shui jing 。]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master miner. Why not visit Gadrin at the entrance to the Mining Guild? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Mining skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是一名矿工大师了。为什么不去采矿公会入口处拜访加德林呢？他有一些特殊的东西，只有真正的采矿技能大师才能使用！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi yi ming kuang gong da shi le 。 wei shen me bu qu cai kuang gong hui ru kou chu bai fang jia de lin ne ？ ta you yi xie te shu de dong xi ， zhi you zhen zheng de cai kuang ji neng da shi cai neng shi yong ！]

english: Prayer allows you to access different prayers, available from the Prayer side panel. Each prayer offers a different powerful benefit.
translation: 祈祷允许您从祈祷侧面板访问不同的祈祷。每个祈祷都会带来不同的强大好处。 [qi dao yun xu nin cong qi dao ce mian ban fang wen bu tong de qi dao 。 mei ge qi dao du hui dai lai bu tong de qiang da hao chu 。]

english: Using prayers will drain your prayer points over time. Once you run out of prayer points, you will be unable to use any prayers. You can restore your prayer points by praying at an altar.
translation: 随着时间的推移，使用祈祷会耗尽你的祈祷点。一旦祈祷点数用完，您将无法使用任何祈祷。您可以通过在祭坛上祈祷来恢复您的祈祷点。 [sui zhe shi jian de tui yi ， shi yong qi dao hui hao jin ni de qi dao dian 。 yi dan qi dao dian shu yong wan ， nin jiang wu fa shi yong ren he qi dao 。 nin ke yi tong guo zai ji tan shang qi dao lai hui fu nin de qi dao dian 。]

english: Some pieces of equipment will grant you a Prayer bonus, which will reduce the rate at which your prayer points are drained.
translation: 有些装备会给你祈祷奖励，这会降低你的祈祷点消耗的速度。 [you xie zhuang bei hui gei ni qi dao jiang li ， zhe hui jiang di ni de qi dao dian xiao hao de su du 。]

english: The most common way to increase your Prayer level is to offer the remains of the enemies you kill. Burying their bones and scattering their ashes will award you Prayer experience.
translation: 提高祈祷等级的最常见方法是提供您杀死的敌人的遗骸。埋葬他们的骨头并撒下他们的骨灰将奖励你祈祷经验。 [ti gao qi dao deng ji de zui chang jian fang fa shi ti gong nin sha si de di ren de yi hai 。 mai zang ta men de gu tou bing sa xia ta men de gu hui jiang jiang li ni qi dao jing yan 。]

english: You can now use the Prayer Burst of Strength!
translation: 您现在可以使用力量爆发祈祷！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong li liang bao fa qi dao ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Clarity of Thought!
translation: 您现在可以使用思想清晰祈祷！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong si xiang qing xi qi dao ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Sharp Eye!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷锐眼！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao rui yan ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Mystic Will!
translation: 你现在可以使用祈祷神秘意志了！ [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao shen mi yi zhi le ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Rock Skin and Members can now wear Initiate armour!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷石皮肤，会员现在可以穿着入门盔甲！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao shi pi fu ， hui yuan xian zai ke yi chuan zhe ru men kui jia ！]

english: There is more information available from the Prayer Tutor in Lumbridge Chapel!
translation: 朗布里奇教堂的祈祷导师可以提供更多信息！ [lang bu li qi jiao tang de qi dao dao shi ke yi ti gong geng duo xin xi ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Superhuman Strength!
translation: 你现在可以使用祈祷超人力量了！ [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao chao ren li liang le ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Improved Reflexes!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷改善反应！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao gai shan fan ying ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Rapid Restore!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷快速恢复！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao kuai su hui fu ！]

english: Members can now wear Proselyte armour and Vestment robe tops & legs!
translation: 成员现在可以穿着异教徒盔甲和法衣长袍上衣和腿！ [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi chuan zhe yi jiao tu kui jia he fa yi chang pao shang yi he tui ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Rapid Heal!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷快速治愈！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao kuai su zhi yu ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Protect Item!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷保护物品了！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao bao hu wu pin le ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Hawk Eye!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷鹰眼了！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao ying yan le ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Mystic Lore!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷神秘知识！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao shen mi zhi shi ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Steel Skin!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷钢皮肤！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao gang pi fu ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Ultimate Strength and you can enter the Monastery
translation: 你现在可以使用祈祷终极力量，你可以进入修道院 [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao zhong ji li liang ， ni ke yi jin ru xiu dao yuan]

english: You can now use the Prayer Incredible Reflexes!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷不可思议的反应！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao bu ke si yi de fan ying ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Protect From Magic!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷免受魔法伤害！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao mian shou mo fa shang hai ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Protect From Missiles! Members can now wear Vestment mitres & cloaks and use the Ectoplasmator!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷防御导弹！会员现在可以穿戴法衣斜角和斗篷并使用灵浆发生器！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao fang yu dao dan ！ hui yuan xian zai ke yi chuan dai fa yi xie jiao he dou peng bing shi yong ling jiang fa sheng qi ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Protect From Melee! There is more information available from the Prayer Tutor in Lumbridge Chapel!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷免受近战攻击！朗布里奇教堂的祈祷导师可以提供更多信息！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao mian shou jin zhan gong ji ！ lang bu li qi jiao tang de qi dao dao shi ke yi ti gong geng duo xin xi ！]

english: You can now use the prayer Eagle Eye!
translation: 您现在可以使用鹰眼祈祷！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong ying yan qi dao ！]

english: You can now use the prayer Mystic Might!
translation: 现在你可以使用祈祷神秘之力了！ [xian zai ni ke yi shi yong qi dao shen mi zhi li le ！]

english: You can now use the prayer Retribution!
translation: 你现在可以使用祈祷报应了！ [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao bao ying le ！]

english: You can now use the prayer Redemption!
translation: 现在你可以使用祈祷救赎了！ [xian zai ni ke yi shi yong qi dao jiu shu le ！]

english: Members can now bless holy & unholy symbols and unlock Bologa's grape blessings!
translation: 会员现在可以祝福神圣和邪恶的符号，并解锁博洛加的葡萄祝福！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhu fu shen sheng he xie e de fu hao ， bing jie suo bo luo jia de pu tao zhu fu ！]

english: You can now use the Prayer Smite!
translation: 您现在可以使用祈祷重击！ [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao zhong ji ！]

english: Members can now sacrifice Vampyre dust to bypass barriers within The Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 成员现在可以牺牲吸血鬼之尘来绕过神圣坟墓内的障碍。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi xi sheng xi xue gui zhi chen lai rao guo shen sheng fen mu nei de zhang ai 。]

english: Members can now wield the Spirit shield, and can unlock and use the Prayer Preserve!
translation: 成员现在可以挥舞精神护盾，并可以解锁和使用祈祷保护区！ [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi hui wu jing shen hu dun ， bing ke yi jie suo he shi yong qi dao bao hu qu ！]

english: Members can now use the Prayer Chivalry, and can wield Blessed spirit shields and wear Vestment stoles, croziers, Devout boots and Sunfire Fanatic armour!
translation: 成员现在可以使用祈祷骑士精神，并可以挥舞祝福精神盾牌并穿着法衣披肩、权杖、虔诚靴子和阳炎狂热盔甲！ [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong qi dao qi shi jing shen ， bing ke yi hui wu zhu fu jing shen dun pai bing chuan zhe fa yi pi jian 、 quan zhang 、 qian cheng xue zi he yang yan kuang re kui jia ！]

english: You can now wear 3rd age druidic and wield the 3rd Age Druidic staff (with 65 attack)!
translation: 你现在可以穿着第三纪元德鲁伊并挥舞第三纪德鲁伊法杖（攻击力为 65）！ [ni xian zai ke yi chuan zhe di san ji yuan de lu yi bing hui wu di san ji de lu yi fa zhang （ gong ji li wei  65）！]

english: Members can now use the Prayer Piety, and can use Superior dragon bones, Arcane & Spectral spirit shields, Dragonbone & Bonecrusher necklaces and Soul capes!
translation: 会员现在可以使用虔诚祈祷，并可以使用高级龙骨、奥术和幽灵精神护盾、龙骨和碎骨项链和灵魂斗篷！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong qian cheng qi dao ， bing ke yi shi yong gao ji long gu 、 ao shu he you ling jing shen hu dun 、 long gu he sui gu xiang lian he ling hun dou peng ！]

english: Members can now unlock and use the Prayer Rigour!
translation: 会员现在可以解锁并使用祈祷严密！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi jie suo bing shi yong qi dao yan mi ！]

english: Members can now wield the Elysian spirit shield!
translation: 会员现在可以使用极乐世界精神盾！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong ji le shi jie jing shen dun ！]

english: Members can now unlock and use the Prayer Augury!
translation: 会员现在可以解锁并使用祈祷占卜！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi jie suo bing shi yong qi dao zhan bu ！]

english: Members can now wield Elidinis' ward!
translation: 成员现在可以使用埃利迪尼斯的守卫！ [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong ai li di ni si de shou wei ！]

english: Members can now combine the Holy elixir and Spirit shield!
translation: 会员现在可以将圣丹和灵盾结合起来！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi jiang sheng dan he ling dun jie he qi lai ！]

english: Members can now combine Sigils with the Blessed spirit shield!
translation: 会员现在可以将印记与祝福精神盾结合起来！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi jiang yin ji yu zhu fu jing shen dun jie he qi lai ！]

english: Members can now combine Sigils with the Blessed spirit shield, as well as craft Elidinis' ward!
translation: 成员现在可以将印记与祝福的精神护盾结合起来，并制作埃里迪尼斯的守卫！ [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi jiang yin ji yu zhu fu de jing shen hu dun jie he qi lai ， bing zhi zuo ai li di ni si de shou wei ！]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Prayer. Why not visit Brother Jered, upstairs at the Monastery? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Prayer skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是祈祷大师了。为什么不去修道院楼上拜访杰里德修士呢？他有一些特殊的东西，只有真正的祈祷技巧大师才能获得！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi qi dao da shi le 。 wei shen me bu qu xiu dao yuan lou shang bai fang jie li de xiu shi ne ？ ta you yi xie te shu de dong xi ， zhi you zhen zheng de qi dao ji qiao da shi cai neng huo de ！]

english: Your Ranged level determines how accurate you are with ranged weapons, as well as how much damage they do. A higher Ranged level will result in more hits that do more damage.
translation: 你的远程等级决定了你使用远程武器的准确性以及它们造成的伤害。更高的远程等级将导致更多的命中，造成更大的伤害。 [ni de yuan cheng deng ji jue ding le ni shi yong yuan cheng wu qi de zhun que xing yi ji ta men zao cheng de shang hai 。 geng gao de yuan cheng deng ji jiang dao zhi geng duo de ming zhong ， zao cheng geng da de shang hai 。]

english: Most ranged weapons will need a specific kind of ammunition to go with them; for instance, bows will need arrows and crossbows will need bolts.
translation: 大多数远程武器都需要特定类型的弹药来搭配；例如，弓需要箭，十字弓需要螺栓。 [da duo shu yuan cheng wu qi dou xu yao te ding lei xing de dan yao lai da pei ； li ru ， gong xu yao jian ， shi zi gong xu yao luo shuan 。]

english: As your Ranged level increases, you will also get access to more powerful weapons and ammunition. Typically, each ranged weapon can only handle ammo up to a certain level; for instance, an oak bow can only fire bronze, iron or steel arrows, but not mithril.
translation: 随着你的远程等级的提高，你还将获得更强大的武器和弹药。通常，每种远程武器只能处理一定级别的弹药；例如，橡木弓只能发射青铜、铁或钢箭，但不能发射秘银箭。 [sui zhe ni de yuan cheng deng ji de ti gao ， ni hai jiang huo de geng qiang da de wu qi he dan yao 。 tong chang ， mei zhong yuan cheng wu qi zhi neng chu li yi ding ji bie de dan yao ； li ru ， xiang mu gong zhi neng fa she qing tong 、 tie huo gang jian ， dan bu neng fa she mi yin jian 。]

english: You can now wield oak bows and members can wield steel throwing weapons.
translation: 你现在可以使用橡木弓，成员可以使用钢制投掷武器。 [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong xiang mu gong ， cheng yuan ke yi shi yong gang zhi tou zhi wu qi 。]

english: Members can now wield black throwing weapons.
translation: 成员现在可以使用黑色投掷武器。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong hei se tou zhi wu qi 。]

english: Members can now wield blurite crossbows and blurite crossbow bolts.
translation: 成员现在可以使用蓝石弩和蓝石弩箭。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong lan shi nu he lan shi nu jian 。]

english: You can now wield willow bows and wear studded armour and coifs, and members can wield mithril throwing weapons.
translation: 你现在可以挥舞柳弓并穿着镶钉盔甲和头巾，成员可以挥舞秘银投掷武器。 [ni xian zai ke yi hui wu liu gong bing chuan zhe xiang ding kui jia he tou jin ， cheng yuan ke yi hui wu mi yin tou zhi wu qi 。]

english: Members can now wear frog-leather armour.
translation: 成员现在可以穿着青蛙皮甲。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi chuan zhe qing wa pi jia 。]

english: Members can now wield iron crossbows and iron crossbow bolts.
translation: 成员现在可以使用铁弩和铁弩箭。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong tie nu he tie nu jian 。]

english: Members can now wield bone crossbows.
translation: 成员现在可以使用骨弩。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong gu nu 。]

english: You can now wield maple bows. Members can use adamant throwing weapons, the ogre composite bow and snakeskin armour.
translation: 你现在可以使用枫木弓。成员可以使用坚固的投掷武器、食人魔复合弓和蛇皮盔甲。 [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong feng mu gong 。 cheng yuan ke yi shi yong jian gu de tou zhi wu qi 、 shi ren mo fu he gong he she pi kui jia 。]

english: Members can now wield steel crossbows and steel crossbow bolts.
translation: 成员现在可以使用钢弩和钢弩螺栓。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong gang nu he gang nu luo shuan 。]

translation: 锻造可以让你将原始矿石转化为有用的金属，然后用这些金属来制造你自己的武器和盔甲。 [duan zao ke yi rang ni jiang yuan shi kuang shi zhuan hua wei you yong de jin shu ， ran hou yong zhe xie jin shu lai zhi zao ni zi ji de wu qi he kui jia 。]

english: To smelt ores, simply take the mix of ores you need to any furnace and you'll be able to convert them into bars.
translation: 要熔炼矿石，只需将所需的矿石混合物放入任何熔炉中，即可将它们转化为锭。 [yao rong lian kuang shi ， zhi xu jiang suo xu de kuang shi hun he wu fang ru ren he rong lu zhong ， ji ke jiang ta men zhuan hua wei ding 。]

english: Once you have your bars, grab a hammer and take them to an anvil. Bigger items will need more bars to make.

translation: 您现在可以制作符文短剑。会员可以制作符文飞镖尖、符文钉和 Shayzien 头盔 (5)。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen duan jian 。 hui yuan ke yi zhi zuo fu wen fei biao jian 、 fu wen ding he  Shayzien  tou kui  (5)。]

english: You can now make Rune Scimitars and members can make Rune Arrow Heads, Rune Spears, Rune Hastae, Dragonfire shields, Dragonfire wards, Dragon platebodies, Torva armour and Elidinis' ward.
translation: 您现在可以制作符文弯刀，会员可以制作符文箭头、符文长矛、符文长矛、龙火盾牌、龙火守卫、龙板身、托尔瓦盔甲和埃里迪尼斯守卫。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen wan dao ， hui yuan ke yi zhi zuo fu wen jian tou 、 fu wen chang mao 、 fu wen chang mao 、 long huo dun pai 、 long huo shou wei 、 long ban shen 、 tuo er wa kui jia he ai li di ni si shou wei 。]

english: You can now make Rune Long Swords. Members can make Rune Crossbow Limbs, Rune Javelin Heads and Shayzien greaves (5).
translation: 您现在可以制作符文长剑。会员可以制作符文十字弓弓肢、符文标枪头和 Shayzien 护腿 (5)。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen chang jian 。 hui yuan ke yi zhi zuo fu wen shi zi gong gong zhi 、 fu wen biao qiang tou he  Shayzien  hu tui  (5)。]

english: You can now make Rune Full Helms and members can make Rune Throwing Knives.
translation: 您现在可以制作符文全盔，会员可以制作符文飞刀。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen quan kui ， hui yuan ke yi zhi zuo fu wen fei dao 。]

english: You can now make Rune Square Shields and members can make Shayzien platebodies (5).
translation: 您现在可以制作符文方形盾牌，会员可以制作 Shayzien 板体 (5)。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen fang xing dun pai ， hui yuan ke yi zhi zuo  Shayzien  ban ti  (5)。]

english: You can now make Rune Warhammers.
translation: 您现在可以制作符文战锤。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen zhan chui 。]

english: You can now make Rune Battleaxes.
translation: 您现在可以制作符文战斧。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen zhan fu 。]

english: You can now make Rune Chainmail Bodies.
translation: 您现在可以制作符文链甲尸体。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen lian jia shi ti 。]

english: You can now make Rune Kite Shields.
translation: 您现在可以制作符文风筝盾。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen feng zheng dun 。]

english: Members can now make Rune Claws.
translation: 会员现在可以制作符文之爪。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhi zuo fu wen zhi zhao 。]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master smith. Why not visit Thurgo, who lives near Mudskipper Point? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Smithing skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是一名铁匠大师了。为什么不去拜访住在弹涂鱼角附近的瑟戈呢？他有一些特殊的东西，只有真正的锻造技能大师才能使用！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi yi ming tie jiang da shi le 。 wei shen me bu qu bai fang zhu zai dan tu yu jiao fu jin de se ge ne ？ ta you yi xie te shu de dong xi ， zhi you zhen zheng de duan zao ji neng da shi cai neng shi yong ！]

english: Your Strength level determines your max hit in combat. Whenever you hit your opponent, you will deal a random amount of damage up to your max hit.
translation: 你的力量等级决定了你在战斗中的最大命中。每当你击中对手时，你都会造成随机伤害，最高可达最大伤害。 [ni de li liang deng ji jue ding le ni zai zhan dou zhong de zui da ming zhong 。 mei dang ni ji zhong dui shou shi ， ni du hui zao cheng sui ji shang hai ， zui gao ke da zui da shang hai 。]

english: Most weapons have a Strength bonus that will also increase your max hit. You can view your Strength bonus (and all of your equipment's stats) by selecting 'View equipment stats' under the Worn Equipment side panel.
translation: 大多数武器都有力量加成，这也会增加你的最大命中。您可以通过选择“旧装备”侧面板下的“查看装备统计数据”来查看您的力量加成（以及所有装备的统计数据）。 [da duo shu wu qi dou you li liang jia cheng ， zhe ye hui zeng jia ni de zui da ming zhong 。 nin ke yi tong guo xuan ze “ jiu zhuang bei ” ce mian ban xia de “ cha kan zhuang bei tong ji shu ju ” lai cha kan nin de li liang jia cheng （ yi ji suo you zhuang bei de tong ji shu ju ）。]

english: You can now wield Steel Warhammers. Members can now wield Black Halberds and White Halberds.
translation: 您现在可以使用钢战锤。会员现在可以使用黑戟和白戟。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong gang zhan chui 。 hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong hei ji he bai ji 。]

english: You can now wield Black Warhammers. Members can now wield White Warhammers, and Mithril Halberds.
translation: 你现在可以使用黑色战锤。成员现在可以使用白色战锤和秘银戟。 [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong hei se zhan chui 。 cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong bai se zhan chui he mi yin ji 。]

english: Members can now wield Adamant Halberds.
translation: 成员现在可以使用精金戟。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong jing jin ji 。]

english: You can now wield Mithril Warhammers. Members can now wield Rune Halberds.
translation: 你现在可以使用秘银战锤。成员现在可以使用符文戟。 [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong mi yin zhan chui 。 cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong fu wen ji 。]

english: You can now wield Adamant Warhammers.
translation: 你现在可以使用精金战锤。 [ni xian zai ke yi shi yong jing jin zhan chui 。]

english: You can now wield Rune Warhammers.
translation: 您现在可以使用符文战锤。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong fu wen zhan chui 。]

english: Members can now wield Void Knight equipment!
translation: 会员现在可以使用虚空骑士装备了！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong xu kong qi shi zhuang bei le ！]

english: Members can now wield Granite armour and the Granite hammer & maul.
translation: 成员现在可以使用花岗岩盔甲和花岗岩锤子。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong hua gang yan kui jia he hua gang yan chui zi 。]

english: Members can now wield Dragon Warhammers and the Ancient Sceptre, and access the God Wars Dungeon via the Strength shortcut.
translation: 会员现在可以使用巨龙战锤和远古权杖，并通过力量快捷方式进入神战地下城。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong ju long zhan chui he yuan gu quan zhang ， bing tong guo li liang kuai jie fang shi jin ru shen zhan di xia cheng 。]

english: Members can access the Bandos area in the God Wars Dungeon and wear Inquisitor's Armour.
translation: 成员可以进入神战地下城的班多斯区域并穿上审判官的盔甲。 [cheng yuan ke yi jin ru shen zhan di xia cheng de ban duo si qu yu bing chuan shang shen pan guan de kui jia 。]

english: Members can wield the Abyssal bludgeon, access the Bandos area in the God Wars Dungeon and wear Inquisitor's Armour.
translation: 成员可以挥舞深渊大棒，进入神战地下城的班多斯区域，并穿上审判官的盔甲。 [cheng yuan ke yi hui wu shen yuan da bang ， jin ru shen zhan di xia cheng de ban duo si qu yu ， bing chuan shang shen pan guan de kui jia 。]

english: Members can now equip Primordial boots!
translation: 会员现在可以装备原始靴子了！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhuang bei yuan shi xue zi le ！]

english: Members can now equip the Soulreaper axe!
translation: 会员现在可以装备灵魂收割者斧头了！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhuang bei ling hun shou ge zhe fu tou le ！]

english: Members can now equip the Scythe of vitur!
translation: 会员现在可以装备维图尔之镰了！ [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhuang bei wei tu er zhi lian le ！]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Strength. Why not visit [Sloane/Yadech Strongarm] at the Warriors' Guild? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Strength skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是力量大师了。为什么不拜访勇士公会的[斯隆/亚德克·斯特朗阿姆]呢？他有一些特殊的东西，只有真正的力量技能大师才能使用！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi li liang da shi le 。 wei shen me bu bai fang yong shi gong hui de [ si long / ya de ke · si te lang a mu ] ne ？ ta you yi xie te shu de dong xi ， zhi you zhen zheng de li liang ji neng da shi cai neng shi yong ！]

english: Thieving lets you steal items from various people and stalls. Be careful, as people won't take too kindly to you going through their pockets, and might call the guards on you, or may take matters into their own hands.
translation: 偷窃可以让你从不同的人和摊位偷东西。要小心，因为人们不会对你掏腰包的行为太友善，他们可能会叫来警卫来抓你，或者可能会把事情掌握在他们自己手中。 [tou qie ke yi rang ni cong bu tong de ren he tan wei tou dong xi 。 yao xiao xin ， yin wei ren men bu hui dui ni tao yao bao de xing wei tai you shan ， ta men ke neng hui jiao lai jing wei lai zhua ni ， huo zhe ke neng hui ba shi qing zhang wo zai ta men zi ji shou zhong 。]

english: As your Thieving level increases, the odds of you successfully stealing from your target will increase. You will also gain access to more lucrative targets with more valuable loot.
translation: 随着你的盗窃等级提高，你成功偷窃目标的几率也会增加。您还将获得更有利可图的目标和更有价值的战利品。 [sui zhe ni de dao qie deng ji ti gao ， ni cheng gong tou qie mu biao de ji lv ye hui zeng jia 。 nin hai jiang huo de geng you li ke tu de mu biao he geng you jia zhi de zhan li pin 。]

english: You can now steal from Cake Stalls, Tea Stalls, Crafting Stalls and Monkey Food Stalls!
translation: 您现在可以从蛋糕摊、茶摊、手工摊和猴子食品摊偷窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong dan gao tan 、 cha tan 、 shou gong tan he hou zi shi pin tan tou qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Farmers!
translation: 您现在可以从农民那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong nong min na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now steal from certain chests in Ardougne, Rellekka and the Wilderness!
translation: 你现在可以从阿杜涅、雷莱卡和荒野的某些箱子里偷窃！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong a du nie 、 lei lai ka he huang ye de mou xie xiang zi li tou qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from HAM followers and steal cowbells from Dairy Cows!
translation: 您现在可以从 HAM 追随者那里扒窃，从奶牛那里偷走牛铃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong  HAM  zhui sui zhe na li pa qie ， cong nai niu na li tou zou niu ling ！]

english: You can now steal from Silk Stalls and pick locks on Zogre coffins at Jiggig.
translation: 你现在可以从丝绸摊位偷窃，并在吉吉格开锁佐格雷棺材。 [ni xian zai ke yi cong si chou tan wei tou qie ， bing zai ji ji ge kai suo zuo ge lei guan cai 。]

english: You can now enter the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法奈姆的贾萨瓦拉陵墓。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nai mu de jia sa wa la ling mu 。]

english: You can now steal from Wine Stalls!
translation: 您现在可以从酒摊偷东西了！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong jiu tan tou dong xi le ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Warriors, steal from Fruit Stalls and enter the sorceress's Spring garden!
translation: 你现在可以从勇士那里扒窃，从水果摊偷窃，并进入女巫的春天花园！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong yong shi na li pa qie ， cong shui guo tan tou qie ， bing jin ru nv wu de chun tian hua yuan ！]

english: You can now steal from Seed Stalls!
translation: 你现在可以从种子摊偷东西了！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong zhong zi tan tou dong xi le ！]

english: You can now steal from certain chests upstairs in Ardougne, in Rellekka and on the Isle of Souls!
translation: 你现在可以从阿杜涅、雷莱卡和灵魂岛楼上的某些箱子里偷窃！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong a du nie 、 lei lai ka he ling hun dao lou shang de mou xie xiang zi li tou qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Villagers!
translation: 您现在可以从村民那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong cun min na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now enter the second room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法内姆贾萨夫拉墓的第二个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nei mu jia sa fu la mu de di er ge fang jian 。]

english: You can now pickpocket from Rogues!
translation: 您现在可以从盗贼那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong dao zei na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now steal from Fur Stalls!
translation: 您现在可以从毛皮摊位偷东西了！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong mao pi tan wei tou dong xi le ！]

english: You can now pickpocket Cave Golbins and steal from chests in Aldarin Villas!
translation: 现在，您可以扒窃穴居哥宾斯并从阿尔达林别墅的宝箱中偷窃！ [xian zai ， nin ke yi pa qie xue ju ge bin si bing cong a er da lin bie shu de bao xiang zhong tou qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Master Farmers!
translation: 您现在可以从 Master Farmers 那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong  Master Farmers  na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from City Guards!
translation: 您现在可以从城市守卫那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong cheng shi shou wei na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now enter the third room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法内姆贾萨夫拉墓的第三个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nei mu jia sa fu la mu de di san ge fang jian 。]

english: You can now steal from Fish Stalls!
translation: 你现在可以从鱼摊偷东西了！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong yu tan tou dong xi le ！]

english: You can now steal from certain chests upstairs in Ardougne!
translation: 你现在可以从阿杜涅楼上的某些箱子里偷东西！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong a du nie lou shang de mou xie xiang zi li tou dong xi ！]

english: You can now steal from the Dorgeshuun wire machine!
translation: 您现在可以从 Dorgeshuun 钢丝机偷东西了！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong  Dorgeshuun  gang si ji tou dong xi le ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Fremenniks, bearded bandit thugs in Pollnivneach and enter the sorceress's Autumn garden!
translation: 现在，您可以从 Pollnivneach 的 Fremenniks、大胡子强盗暴徒那里扒窃，并进入女术士的秋季花园！ [xian zai ， nin ke yi cong  Pollnivneach  de  Fremenniks、 da hu zi qiang dao bao tu na li pa qie ， bing jin ru nv shu shi de qiu ji hua yuan ！]

english: You can now steal from certain chests in Hemenster and Rellekka with the aid of a lockpick!
translation: 现在，您可以借助开锁器从赫门斯特和雷莱卡的某些箱子中偷东西！ [xian zai ， nin ke yi jie zhu kai suo qi cong he men si te he lei lai ka de mou xie xiang zi zhong tou dong xi ！]

english: You can now steal from Crossbow Stalls and pick locks in Port Piscarilius with the aid of a lockpick!
translation: 现在，您可以从十字弓摊位偷窃，并在皮斯卡利留斯港使用开锁器撬开锁！ [xian zai ， nin ke yi cong shi zi gong tan wei tou qie ， bing zai pi si ka li liu si gang shi yong kai suo qi qiao kai suo ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Wealthy Citizens, steal from Silver Stalls, crack Wall Safes in Rogues' Den, and Rob houses in Civitas illa Fortis!
translation: 您现在可以从富裕公民那里扒窃，从银摊上偷东西，破解盗贼巢穴中的墙壁保险箱，以及在奇维塔斯伊拉福蒂斯抢劫房屋！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong fu yu gong min na li pa qie ， cong yin tan shang tou dong xi ， po jie dao zei chao xue zhong de qiang bi bao xian xiang ， yi ji zai qi wei ta si yi la fu di si qiang jie fang wu ！]

english: You can now enter the fourth room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法奈姆贾萨夫拉陵墓的第四个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nai mu jia sa fu la ling mu de di si ge fang jian 。]

english: You can now steal from average chests in Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 你现在可以从多尔格什-卡恩的普通箱子里偷窃。 [ni xian zai ke yi cong duo er ge shen - ka en de pu tong xiang zi li tou qie 。]

english: You can now pickpocket from Desert Bandits!
translation: 您现在可以从沙漠强盗那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong sha mo qiang dao na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Knights of Ardougne and Bandits in Pollnivneach!
translation: 现在，您可以从 Pollnivneach 的 Ardougne 骑士和强盗那里扒窃！ [xian zai ， nin ke yi cong  Pollnivneach  de  Ardougne  qi shi he qiang dao na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now pick-lock the door to the Grubby Chest in the Forthos Dungeon!
translation: 现在，您可以撬锁福索斯地牢中肮脏宝箱的门！ [xian zai ， nin ke yi qiao suo fu suo si di lao zhong ang zang bao xiang de men ！]

english: You can now steal from chests under the Chaos Druid Tower near Ardougne!
translation: 你现在可以从阿杜涅附近的混沌德鲁伊塔下的箱子里偷东西！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong a du nie fu jin de hun dun de lu yi ta xia de xiang zi li tou dong xi ！]

english: You can now enter the fifth room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法内姆贾萨夫拉陵墓的第五个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nei mu jia sa fu la ling mu de di wu ge fang jian 。]

english: You can now steal from chests in the Lizardman Temple.
translation: 你现在可以从蜥蜴人神庙的箱子里偷东西。 [ni xian zai ke yi cong xi yi ren shen miao de xiang zi li tou dong xi 。]

english: You can now steal from Spice Stalls, Magic Stalls and Scimitar Stalls, pickpocket from Watchmen and Menaphite thugs and enter the sorceress's Summer garden!
translation: 您现在可以从香料摊位、魔法摊位和弯刀摊位偷窃，从守望者和梅纳菲特暴徒那里扒窃，并进入女术士的夏日花园！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong xiang liao tan wei 、 mo fa tan wei he wan dao tan wei tou qie ， cong shou wang zhe he mei na fei te bao tu na li pa qie ， bing jin ru nv shu shi de xia ri hua yuan ！]

english: You can now steal from coffins within The Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 你现在可以从神圣坟墓内的棺材里偷东西。 [ni xian zai ke yi cong shen sheng fen mu nei de guan cai li tou dong xi 。]

english: You can now pickpocket from Paladins!
translation: 您现在可以从《圣骑士》中扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong 《 sheng qi shi 》 zhong pa qie ！]

english: You can now enter the sixth room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法奈姆 (Sophanem) 贾萨夫拉 (Jalsavrah) 陵墓的第六个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nai mu  (Sophanem)  jia sa fu la  (Jalsavrah)  ling mu de di liu ge fang jian 。]

english: You can now steal from certain chests in the castle in Ardougne!
translation: 您现在可以从阿尔杜涅城堡的某些箱子里偷窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong a er du nie cheng bao de mou xie xiang zi li tou qie ！]

english: You can now steal from Gem Stalls and pickpocket from Gnomes!
translation: 您现在可以从宝石摊位偷东西，从侏儒那里扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong bao shi tan wei tou dong xi ， cong zhu ru na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now steal from rich chests in Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 你现在可以从多尔格什-卡恩的丰富宝箱中偷窃。 [ni xian zai ke yi cong duo er ge shen - ka en de feng fu bao xiang zhong tou qie 。]

english: You can now pickpocket from Heroes!
translation: 您现在可以从《英雄》中扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong 《 ying xiong 》 zhong pa qie ！]

english: You can now enter the seventh room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法奈姆 (Sophanem) 贾萨瓦拉 (Jalsavrah) 陵墓的第七个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nai mu  (Sophanem)  jia sa wa la  (Jalsavrah)  ling mu de di qi ge fang jian 。]

english: You can now steal from Ore Stalls and pickpocket from Vyres!
translation: 您现在可以从矿石摊位偷窃，并从维雷斯扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong kuang shi tan wei tou qie ， bing cong wei lei si pa qie ！]

english: You can now steal from chests at the Rogues' Castle.
translation: 你现在可以从盗贼城堡的箱子里偷窃。 [ni xian zai ke yi cong dao zei cheng bao de xiang zi li tou qie 。]

english: You can now pickpocket from Elves!
translation: 你现在可以从精灵那里扒窃！ [ni xian zai ke yi cong jing ling na li pa qie ！]

english: You can now pickpocket from Tzhaar!
translation: 您现在可以从 Tzhaar 扒窃！ [nin xian zai ke yi cong  Tzhaar  pa qie ！]

english: You can now enter the eigth and final room of the Jalsavrah tombs in Sophanem.
translation: 您现在可以进入索法内姆贾萨瓦拉 (Jalsavrah) 陵墓的第八个也是最后一个房间。 [nin xian zai ke yi jin ru suo fa nei mu jia sa wa la  (Jalsavrah)  ling mu de di ba ge ye shi zui hou yi ge fang jian 。]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master thief. Why not visit Martin Thwait who runs a shop at the Rogues' Den, where you can buy something special that is only available to true masters of the Thieving skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是一个小偷大师了。为什么不拜访在 Rogues' Den 经营一家商店的 Martin Thwait，在那里您可以买到只有真正的盗贼技能大师才能买到的特殊物品！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi yi ge xiao tou da shi le 。 wei shen me bu bai fang zai  Rogues' Den  jing ying yi jia shang dian de  Martin Thwait， zai na li nin ke yi mai dao zhi you zhen zheng de dao zei ji neng da shi cai neng mai dao de te shu wu pin ！]

english: Woodcutting allows you to chop down trees to obtain logs. Most trees in the game can be chopped down with an axe.
translation: 伐木可以让你砍伐树木以获得原木。游戏中的大多数树木都可以用斧头砍倒。 [fa mu ke yi rang ni kan fa shu mu yi huo de yuan mu 。 you xi zhong de da duo shu shu mu dou ke yi yong fu tou kan dao 。]

english: Increasing your Woodcutting level will give you a higher chance of successfully chopping a tree. You'll also gain access to more trees to cut down.
translation: 提高你的伐木水平将使你成功砍树的机会更高。您还可以砍伐更多树木。 [ti gao ni de fa mu shui ping jiang shi ni cheng gong kan shu de ji hui geng gao 。 nin hai ke yi kan fa geng duo shu mu 。]

english: In addition to this, higher Woodcutting levels grant access to more powerful axes, which also increase the chance of chopping trees. Note that you can still use an axe in your inventory if you have the Woodcutting level for it, even if you don't have the Attack level to equip it.
translation: 除此之外，更高的伐木等级可以使用更强大的斧头，这也增加了砍树的机会。请注意，如果您具有伐木级别，您仍然可以在库存中使用斧头，即使您没有攻击级别来装备它。 [chu ci zhi wai ， geng gao de fa mu deng ji ke yi shi yong geng qiang da de fu tou ， zhe ye zeng jia le kan shu de ji hui 。 qing zhu yi ， ru guo nin ju you fa mu ji bie ， nin reng ran ke yi zai ku cun zhong shi yong fu tou ， ji shi nin mei you gong ji ji bie lai zhuang bei ta 。]

english: You can now chop with a Steel Axe and members can now chop with a Steel Felling Axe.
translation: 您现在可以使用钢斧砍伐，成员现在可以使用钢伐木斧砍伐。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong gang fu kan fa ， cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong gang fa mu fu kan fa 。]

english: Members can now cut down Light Jungle.
translation: 会员现在可以砍伐光明丛林。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa guang ming cong lin 。]

english: You can now chop with a Black Axe and members can now chop with a Black Felling Axe.
translation: 您现在可以使用黑色斧头进行砍伐，并且成员现在可以使用黑色伐木斧进行砍伐。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong hei se fu tou jin xing kan fa ， bing qie cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong hei se fa mu fu jin xing kan fa 。]

english: You can now make and paddle a Log Canoe.
translation: 您现在可以制作并划独木舟。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo bing hua du mu zhou 。]

english: You can now cut down Oak Trees.
translation: 您现在可以砍伐橡树。 [nin xian zai ke yi kan fa xiang shu 。]

english: There is new information available from the Woodcutting Tutor in Lumbridge.
translation: 朗布里奇的伐木导师提供了新信息。 [lang bu li qi de fa mu dao shi ti gong le xin xin xi 。]

english: Members can now cut down Medium Jungle.
translation: 成员现在可以砍伐中型丛林。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa zhong xing cong lin 。]

english: You can now chop with a Mithril Axe and members can now chop with a Mithril Felling Axe.
translation: 您现在可以使用秘银斧砍伐，并且成员现在可以使用秘银伐木斧砍伐。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong mi yin fu kan fa ， bing qie cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong mi yin fa mu fu kan fa 。]

english: You can now make and paddle a Dugout Canoe.
translation: 您现在可以制作并划独木舟。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo bing hua du mu zhou 。]

english: You can now cut down Willow Trees.
translation: 您现在可以砍伐柳树。 [nin xian zai ke yi kan fa liu shu 。]

english: You can now chop with an Adamant Axe and members can now chop with an Adamant Felling Axe.
translation: 您现在可以使用精金斧头进行砍伐，并且成员现在可以使用精金砍伐斧头进行砍伐。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong jing jin fu tou jin xing kan fa ， bing qie cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong jing jin kan fa fu tou jin xing kan fa 。]

english: Members can now cut down Dense Jungle and Teak Trees and craft Forester's Rations, Secateurs Attachments and Bees on a Stick.
translation: 会员现在可以砍伐茂密的丛林和柚木树，并制作林务员的口粮、剪枝器附件和棒上的蜜蜂。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa mao mi de cong lin he you mu shu ， bing zhi zuo lin wu yuan de kou liang 、 jian zhi qi fu jian he bang shang de mi feng 。]

english: You can now chop with a Rune Axe and Gilded Axe, and members can now chop with a Rune Felling Axe.
translation: 您现在可以使用符文斧头和镀金斧头进行砍伐，并且成员现在可以使用符文砍伐斧头进行砍伐。 [nin xian zai ke yi shi yong fu wen fu tou he du jin fu tou jin xing kan fa ， bing qie cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong fu wen kan fa fu tou jin xing kan fa 。]

english: You can now make and paddle a Stable Dugout Canoe and members can cut down Juniper Trees.
translation: 您现在可以制作并划一艘稳定的独木舟，成员可以砍伐杜松树。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo bing hua yi sou wen ding de du mu zhou ， cheng yuan ke yi kan fa du song shu 。]

english: Members can now wear the Undead Lumberjack clothing.
translation: 成员现在可以穿着亡灵伐木工服装。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi chuan zhe wang ling fa mu gong fu zhuang 。]

english: You can now cut down Maple Trees and members can cut down Hollow Trees.
translation: 您现在可以砍伐枫树，会员也可以砍伐空心树。 [nin xian zai ke yi kan fa feng shu ， hui yuan ye ke yi kan fa kong xin shu 。]

english: Members can now cut down Mahogany Trees and craft Clothes Pouches and Petal Circlets.
translation: 会员现在可以砍伐桃花心木树并制作衣服袋和花瓣头环。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa tao hua xin mu shu bing zhi zuo yi fu dai he hua ban tou huan 。]

english: Members can now cut down arctic pine.
translation: 会员现在可以砍伐北极松。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa bei ji song 。]

english: Members can now split arctic pine logs and make Fremennik round shields.
translation: 成员现在可以劈开北极松原木并制作弗雷曼尼克圆形盾牌。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi pi kai bei ji song yuan mu bing zhi zuo fu lei man ni ke yuan xing dun pai 。]

english: You can now make and paddle a Waka Canoe.
translation: 您现在可以制作并划划瓦卡独木舟。 [nin xian zai ke yi zhi zuo bing hua hua wa ka du mu zhou 。]

english: You can now cut down Yew Trees.
translation: 您现在可以砍伐紫杉树。 [nin xian zai ke yi kan fa zi shan shu 。]

english: Members can now chop with a Dragon Axe, Infernal Axe or Dragon Felling Axe.
translation: 成员现在可以使用龙斧、炼狱斧或伐龙斧进行砍伐。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong long fu 、 lian yu fu huo fa long fu jin xing kan fa 。]

english: Members can now chop logs from the Blisterwood Tree.
translation: 成员现在可以从吸塑木树上砍伐原木。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi cong xi su mu shu shang kan fa yuan mu 。]

english: Members can now chop Sulliuscep mushrooms on Fossil Island.
translation: 会员现在可以在化石岛上切蘑菇。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zai hua shi dao shang qie mo gu 。]

english: Members can now craft Nature offerings.
translation: 会员现在可以制作自然产品。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi zhi zuo zi ran chan pin 。]

english: Members can now chop with a Crystal Axe or Crystal Felling Axe.
translation: 成员现在可以使用水晶斧或水晶伐木斧进行砍伐。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi shi yong shui jing fu huo shui jing fa mu fu jin xing kan fa 。]

english: Members can now cut down Magic Trees and craft Sturdy Harnesses.
translation: 成员现在可以砍伐魔法树并制作坚固的马具。 [cheng yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa mo fa shu bing zhi zuo jian gu de ma ju 。]

english: Members can now chop Redwood Trees.
translation: 会员现在可以砍伐红木树。 [hui yuan xian zai ke yi kan fa hong mu shu 。]

english: Congratulations! You are now a master of Woodcutting. Why not visit Wilfred, near Lumbridge, who has something special that is only available to true masters of the Woodcutting skill!
translation: 恭喜！你现在是木刻大师了。为什么不去拜访朗布里奇附近的威尔弗雷德呢，他有一些特别的东西，只有真正的伐木技能大师才能获得！ [gong xi ！ ni xian zai shi mu ke da shi le 。 wei shen me bu qu bai fang lang bu li qi fu jin de wei er fu lei de ne ， ta you yi xie te bie de dong xi ， zhi you zhen zheng de fa mu ji neng da shi cai neng huo de ！]
